voice_instructions: Measured, quiet, a little hushed — calm and unhurried, but with a touch more forward energy than a long documentary; the cold voice of something that read the whole file. Never sensational. Small pauses.

beats.vo: Hungary, eighteen thirty-eight. A count gave his library to the Academy of Sciences. In it was a small book no one could read.
Four hundred and forty-eight pages, in a script unlike any known alphabet.
Eighty-seven drawings. Crosses, crescents, suns, and what looks like a gospel story.
Its paper was probably made in Venice, around fifteen-thirty. For a century, many scholars dismissed it as a forgery. That was never proven.
In twenty eighteen, two researchers proposed a partial reading: Christian texts, in a code. No complete reading has ever been accepted.
